deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel StructureMatcher comparison
process_structure_group_clustering: apply greedy crystallographic clustering to a group of structures using StructureMatcher with configurable lattice and angle tolerances
deduplicate_with_custom_tolerance: deduplicate crystal structures with custom lattice tolerance, site tolerance, and angle tolerance parameters
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures and remove duplicate entries keeping one representative per group
review_deduplicate_structures: review the deduplicate_structures function for its two-stage hash pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison approach
